text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Seems the injury was worse than I thought... The pain is startin' to flare up.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...However, this is an era of fierce rivalry—
the other Umamusume won't let this chance slip by."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Strategist, I have a request, knowing full well it is unreasonable.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Would you permit me to continue training?
I must avoid letting my rivals get ahead of me during this window at all costs...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I shall certainly prepare a reward!
Though your choices are either manju or cola!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
choice_data_list: No... right now, you need absolute bed rest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
choice_data_list: Still, I'll definitely come up with a regimen to make up for it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "...To handle that menu, what you need right now is rest."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Strategist, I shall place my trust in you.
I look forward to your efforts once my rest is over!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Of course, I won't do anything reckless, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Was I being too hasty...?
It seems resting quietly is best after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, No Reason headed back to the dorm
to get some well-deserved rest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Mm!
Something of this level is a piece of cake for me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This is also thanks to you, Master Tactician.
You have my thanks!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was within limits, No Reason
happily moved her body around.
